text: Unicorn socks adorned her feet. A blur of pink and white flailed as Lisa slapped the tops of her feet against the couch.
Though the couch concealed her cry, there was no shield against her previous bout of shouting.
She dissolved into her own emotions, and by the time she’d finally stopped screaming, Marcus had already hung up his keys, taken off his coat, and rolled up his shirt sleeves.
Are you a child, Lisa?
Her scream, shrill in pitch but deep with resonance, was dampened slightly by the dense, blue, couch cushion.
Marcus only called her that when he felt she’d misbehaved like a child. When he was in that frame of mind that didn’t bode well for a specific part of her anatomy.
Lisa didn’t hear the jingling keys in the lock, nor did she hear the door hinges creak as Marcus walked inside and closed the door.
I’m just tired of being tired!
His jaw was tight, his thick brow slightly furrowed, and the usual smile that adorned his lips formed a thin line.
But you and I are going to discuss that childish display, little girl. You are not a toddler. And in this house when you act like a child you will be treated like one.
She found love and tenderness but also resolve and a sternness that carried determination.
And good little girls know better than to curse, don’t they?
I know you’ve had a lot on your plate, and I know you’ve been stressed. But when you are feeling overwhelmed I expect you to come to me.
But the hairbrush is mean.
Marcus loved having it on display, so every time Lisa walked past she knew it would be thoroughly applied to her bottom if she stepped out of line.
That stomp just earned you five extras.
The weight of it caused her stomach to drop, and butterflies to dance in her chest.
Hmmm, twenty-six? A grown woman. And yet I come home to find you throwing a fit worthy of a five-year-old.
Lisa’s heart swelled at those words. Her lips curled up in a bashful smile as she savored his praise.
You can answer me now or after I spank you. But if I have to spank you first, that spanking will be for your disobedience. Your choice.
So because you chose to act this way, what’s going to happen to you, little girl?
Yes, you did, but that little bit of attitude has earned you more. And since you want to argue, now it’s ten.
Those words were the soothing balm Lisa needed to get through the rest of her punishment.
All the while, he rubbed her back and her bottom and whispered sweet praises into her ear, letting her know that she was a good girl and he was proud of her.
That’s quite enough, young lady.
I know, baby. You’re forgiven.
